description: The agents the Chat page can start (0.74.0, docs/ai.md, A3). Data, checked by the host: a new agent is a row. Each is its own program the person installs and logs in to with its own tools; the Companion only starts the command named here, by name from the system's search path, never installs anything, and never passes a login. get: where the person gets it, in words. Commands read from each agent's own pages on 23 Nov 2026.

agents.name: Claude (Claude Agent)
agents.get: Install Node.js, then run: npm install -g @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp. It uses your Claude login.

agents.name: Codex
agents.get: Install Node.js, then run: npm install -g @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp. It uses your ChatGPT login or an OpenAI key.

agents.name: Gemini CLI
agents.get: Install Gemini CLI (npm install -g @google/gemini-cli) and sign in with it once.

agents.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
agents.get: Install GitHub Copilot CLI and sign in with it once.

agents.name: Goose
agents.get: Install Goose and set up its model provider once.
